simple.prompt: Please ___ the lights before you leave the conference room.
simple.explanation: Turn off berarti mematikan perangkat elektronik atau lampu.

simple.prompt: The flight was delayed, but the aircraft finally ___ at 10:15 a.m.
simple.explanation: Take off untuk pesawat berarti lepas landas meninggalkan landasan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat phrasal verb dengan look for.
simple.targetSentence: I am looking for my car keys.
simple.explanation: Look for berarti mencari sesuatu yang hilang.
hints: Mulai dengan I am looking for.

simple.prompt: She wants to ___ smoking to improve her long-term cardiovascular health.
simple.explanation: Give up berarti berhenti total dari suatu kebiasaan (quit/stop).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan phrasal verb put on.
simple.targetSentence: He put on his warm winter coat.
simple.explanation: Put on berarti mengenakan pakaian pada tubuh.

simple.prompt: Can you please ___ this application form before the deadline?
simple.explanation: Fill in atau fill out berarti mengisi formulir dokumen.

simple.targetSentence: She wakes up at six every morning.
simple.explanation: Wake up berarti terbangun dari tidur.
hints: Keterangan waktu: at six every morning.

simple.prompt: Don't forget to ___ the office lights before locking the front door.
simple.explanation: 'Turn off' berarti mematikan perangkat listrik atau lampu.

simple.prompt: Due to the coastal storm, the outdoor concert was ___ until next Saturday.
simple.explanation: 'Put off' bermakna menunda jadwal suatu acara (setara 'postpone').

simple.prompt: Could you help me ___ who sent this unmarked parcel?
simple.explanation: 'Find out' berarti mencari tahu atau menemukan informasi fakta.

simple.prompt: If you don't know that technical abbreviation, ___ it ___ in the glossary!
simple.explanation: 'Look up' berarti mencari informasi/kata tertentu dalam kamus, daftar, atau glosarium.
hints: Mencari kata di kamus memakai 'look up'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang staf dengan phrasal verb menyerah/berhenti.
dialogue: Trainee
This pivot table formula feels tricky at first!
Mentor
Just keep practicing for ten minutes — don't ___ yet!
simple.explanation: 'Give up' berarti menyerah atau berhenti berusaha.
hints: Menyerah dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'give up'.

simple.prompt: Our coordinator ___ a practical suggestion during the morning stand-up.
simple.explanation: 'Bring up' (V2: 'brought up') berarti mengangkat atau mengemukakan topik/saran dalam rapat.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penempatan kata ganti objek ('it') pada separable phrasal verb berikut.
simple.draft: That invoice is confidential, so please don't throw away it in the open bin.
options: That invoice is confidential, so please don't throw it away in the open bin.
That invoice is confidential, so please don't throw away in it the open bin.
That invoice is confidential, so please don't throw it off in the open bin.
simple.explanation: Untuk separable phrasal verb seperti 'throw away', jika objeknya berupa PRONOUN ('it', 'them', 'me'), pronoun WAJIB disisipkan di tengah antara verb dan partikel ('throw it away').
hints: Pronoun 'it' tidak boleh diletakkan setelah partikel 'away'.

simple.prompt: Can you ___ the regional director at the airport around three o'clock?
simple.explanation: 'Pick up' (menjemput seseorang di bandara/stasiun atau mengambil barang).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai separable phrasal verb 'fill out' dengan objek benda.
simple.targetSentence: Please fill out this visitor registration form before entering.
simple.explanation: Dengan kata benda biasa ('this visitor registration form'), partikel 'out' boleh menempel dengan 'fill' atau diletakkan setelahnya.
hints: Awali dengan 'Please fill out this visitor registration form'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan 'carry on' bermakna melanjutkan.
simple.targetSentence: Despite the brief power flicker, the speakers carried on smoothly.
simple.explanation: 'Carry on' berarti terus melanjutkan aktivitas yang sedang berjalan.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Despite the brief power flicker,'.
Akhiri dengan 'the speakers carried on smoothly'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan aturan pemisahan pronoun objek (separable phrasal verb).
dialogue: Manager
Did you examine the quarterly financial audit?
Analyst
Yes, I picked it up from the printer and looked ___ immediately.
intermediate.explanation: Look through adalah inseparable prepositional phrasal verb; objek pronoun diletakkan setelah preposisi: looked through it.

intermediate.prompt: Separable rule with pronouns: 'Please turn ___ right now; the baby is sleeping.'
intermediate.explanation: Pada separable phrasal verb (seperti turn off), jika objek berupa PRONOUN (it, them, him), pronoun WAJIB diletakkan di tengah di antara verb dan partikel: turn it off (pantang *turn off it).
hints: Objek pronoun 'it' wajib diapit di tengah.

intermediate.prompt: Due to the torrential thunderstorm, the committee decided to ___ the outdoor tournament.
intermediate.explanation: Call off adalah idiom yang bermakna membatalkan (cancel).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penundaan dengan put off.
intermediate.targetSentence: Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
hints: Mulai dengan Never put off until tomorrow.
Lanjutkan dengan what you can do today.

intermediate.prompt: I ___ an old photograph album while cleaning out the attic.
intermediate.explanation: Come across berarti menemukan sesuatu secara tidak sengaja/kebetulan (find by chance).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan run out of.
intermediate.targetSentence: We have run out of printer paper.
intermediate.explanation: Run out of berarti kehabisan persediaan.
hints: Subject: We have run out of.

dialogue: Director
Have we identified why the database latency surged?
DevOps
Not yet, but the engineering team is ___ the root cause.
intermediate.explanation: Look into bermakna menyelidiki atau menginvestigasi (investigate).

intermediate.prompt: Our delivery van ___ on the highway, so we hired an emergency tow truck.
intermediate.explanation: 'Break down' (untuk kendaraan/mesin) berarti mogok atau rusak sehingga berhenti berfungsi.
hints: Kendaraan memerlukan truk derek karena mogok.

intermediate.prompt: Sadly, the vendor ___ our revised price proposal because it fell below their cost margin.
intermediate.explanation: 'Turn down' berarti menolak tawaran/lamaran/usulan (atau mengecilkan volume).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang persediaan yang habis.
dialogue: Assistant
Should I order toner cartridges today?
Clerk
Yes! We are about to ___ black ink.
intermediate.explanation: Three-part phrasal verb 'run out of' berarti kehabisan persediaan suatu barang.

intermediate.prompt: Notice that 'look after' is INSEPARABLE: which sentence is correct?
options: My neighbor kindly looked after my houseplants while I was away.
My neighbor kindly looked my houseplants after while I was away.
My neighbor kindly looked them after while I was away.
intermediate.explanation: 'Look after' (merawat/menjaga) adalah inseparable phrasal verb; objek ('my houseplants' maupun pronoun) TIDAK boleh menyisip di antara 'look' dan 'after'.

intermediate.prompt: We need to ___ our quarterly expenses before approving any bonus pool.
intermediate.explanation: 'Cut down on' berarti mengurangi jumlah pemakaian atau pengeluaran.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan phrasal verb yang tidak dapat dipisah pada kalimat berikut.
intermediate.draft: While cleaning the storage shelf, Maya came an old blueprint across.
options: While cleaning the storage shelf, Maya came across an old blueprint.
While cleaning the storage shelf, Maya came it across.
While cleaning the storage shelf, Maya put across an old blueprint.
intermediate.explanation: 'Come across' (menemukan secara tidak sengaja) adalah inseparable phrasal verb; jangan pernah meletakkan objek di antara 'come' dan 'across'.

intermediate.prompt: It took weeks of brainstorming before the engineers ___ an affordable cooling mechanism.
intermediate.explanation: 'Come up with' berarti menemukan atau menghasilkan ide, solusi, atau rencana.

intermediate.prompt: The night manager had to ___ an angry customer politely while checking the receipt.
intermediate.explanation: 'Deal with' berarti menangani atau menghadapi situasi/orang.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai three-part phrasal verb 'put up with'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Commuters shouldn't have to put up with unreliable signal displays.
intermediate.explanation: 'Put up with' berarti bersabar menoleransi hal yang mengganggu.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai separable phrasal verb berobjek pronoun.
intermediate.targetSentence: We drafted a backup schedule, yet the director called it off.
intermediate.explanation: 'Call off' (membatalkan) memaksa pronoun 'it' berada di tengah: 'called it off'.
hints: Awali dengan 'We drafted a backup schedule,'.
Akhiri dengan 'yet the director called it off'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki penempatan pronoun yang keliru pada separable phrasal verb.
complex.draft: The loud radio was disturbing the study session, so she turned off it.
options: The loud radio was disturbing the study session, so she turned it off.
The loud radio was disturbing the study session, so she turned it off from.
The loud radio was disturbing the study session, so she turn it off.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan umum: menempatkan pronoun 'it' setelah partikel pada separable verb. Bentuk wajib: turned it off.
hints: Pronoun objek wajib berada di tengah verb dan partikel.

complex.prompt: Three-part phrasal verb: 'Our legal department will not ___ unethical business practices.'
complex.explanation: Three-part phrasal verb 'put up with' berarti mentoleransi atau tahan terhadap sesuatu (tolerate).

complex.prompt: The government decided to ___ the outdated procurement regulations.
complex.explanation: Do away with adalah idiom yang berarti menghapuskan atau meniadakan (abolish/eliminate).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat three-part phrasal verb dengan look down on.
complex.targetSentence: You should not look down on others.
complex.explanation: Look down on berarti memandang rendah orang lain (feel superior to).
hints: Phrasal verb: look down on others.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan pemisahan pada inseparable verb.
complex.draft: The babysitter looked the toddler after until the parents arrived.
options: The babysitter looked after the toddler until the parents arrived.
The babysitter looked after to the toddler until the parents arrived.
The babysitter was looked after the toddler until the parents arrived.
complex.explanation: Look after (merawat) adalah inseparable prepositional verb; objeknya WAJIB berada setelah partikel: looked after the toddler.

complex.prompt: How did the criminal organization manage to ___ with laundering millions of dollars?
complex.explanation: Get away with berarti lolos dari hukuman atas suatu kesalahan/kejahatan (escape punishment).

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi profesional dengan phrasal verb formal.
dialogue: Manager
Have you reconciled the discrepancy between the invoices?
Auditor
Yes, the calculation difference ___ a rounding divergence in currency conversion.
complex.explanation: Boil down to berarti pada intinya mengerucut pada suatu hal pokok (amount to / be summarized as).

complex.prompt: Because the new intern works with meticulous speed, it is hard for others to ___ her output.
complex.explanation: 'Keep up with' berarti menyamai kecepatan atau perkembangan seseorang/sesuatu.
hints: Rekan lain kesulitan mengimbangi kecepatan kerjanya.

complex.prompt: During the financial audit, our team ___ several overlooked duplicate invoices from 2021.
complex.explanation: 'Come across' / 'stumble upon' berarti menemukan secara kebetulan di tengah penelusuran dokumen.
hints: Menemukan sesuatu tanpa sengaja saat memeriksa arsip.
Pilih frasa yang bermakna menemukan secara tak terduga.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan makna dan partikel pada phrasal verb formal berikut.
complex.draft: The board decided to do out with outdated paper vouchers next quarter.
options: The board decided to do away with outdated paper vouchers next quarter.
The board decided to do up with outdated paper vouchers next quarter.
The board decided to do off with outdated paper vouchers next quarter.
complex.explanation: Idiom phrasal verb yang tepat untuk 'menghapuskan/menghentikan sistem lama' adalah 'do away with' (bukan 'do out with').
hints: Ungkapan tiga-bagian yang tepat adalah 'do away with'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penebusan kesalahan layanan ('make up for').
dialogue: Director
Our late freight delivery frustrated the client in Surabaya.
Account Lead
Right — we can ___ that delay by offering complimentary express handling this month.
complex.explanation: 'Make up for' berarti mengompensasi atau menebus kekurangan/kesalahan sebelumnya.

complex.prompt: In formal academic writing, 'put off' is best replaced by the single Latinate verb '___' to preserve objective register.
complex.explanation: 'Put off' bermakna menunda ('postpone' atau 'defer'), bukan membatalkan ('cancel' = 'call off').

complex.prompt: After procrastinating for two weeks, he finally ___ organizing the tax folders.
complex.explanation: 'Get round to (+ V-ing)' berarti akhirnya sempat atau menyempatkan diri mengerjakan sesuatu yang tertunda.
hints: Akhirnya sempat mengerjakan tugas yang lama ditunda.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyisipkan objek panjang di antara phrasal verb yang bisa dipisah vs tidak masuk akal bila terlalu panjang.
complex.draft: Please write every single serial number from all fifty cardboard crates downstairs down immediately.
options: Please write down every single serial number from all fifty cardboard crates downstairs immediately.
Please write down them immediately from all fifty cardboard crates downstairs.
Please write every single serial number down from all fifty crates downstairs immediately.
complex.explanation: Meskipun 'write down' bersifat separable, jika objeknya sangat panjang (heavy noun phrase: 'every single serial number from all fifty cardboard crates downstairs'), partikel 'down' WAJIB langsung menempel setelah verb ('write down + objek panjang') demi kejelasan baca!
hints: Objek noun phrase yang sangat panjang memaksa partikel tetap dekat dengan verb.

complex.prompt: True leadership means managers ___ their junior staff when an unfair complaint arises.
complex.explanation: 'Stand up for' berarti membela atau mendukung seseorang secara terbuka saat menghadapi perlakuan tidak adil.
hints: Membela staf saat ada keluhan tidak adil.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai three-part phrasal verb 'live up to'.
complex.targetSentence: The upgraded electric bus fully lived up to the city's strict range expectations.
complex.explanation: 'Live up to + expectations/standards' berarti memenuhi harapan atau standar tinggi.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The upgraded electric bus fully lived up to'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan 'account for' (menjelaskan porsi/penyebab) pada ragam laporan.
complex.targetSentence: Mobile checkout orders now account for nearly sixty percent of weekend revenue.
complex.explanation: 'Account for' adalah inseparable prepositional verb yang berarti menyumbang porsi atau menjadi penjelasan.
hints: Awali dengan 'Mobile checkout orders now account for'.
